```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE, 
  warning = FALSE, 
  message = FALSE,
  fig.path = "results_files/figure-gfm/"
)
library(here)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(dplyr)
```

# Load processed results

```{r}
results <- readRDS(here::here("tmp/processed_results.rds"))
```

# Define colors for models

```{r}
model_colors <- c(
  "Manifest only" = "#009E73",
  "Manifest + latent descriptors" = "#E69F00",
  "Manifest + latent process" = "#0072B2"
)
```

## Cross-Validation Results

### ROC Curves

```{r roc-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=8}
ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = results$ci_data,  
              aes(x = FPR, 
                  ymin = lower, 
                  ymax = upper,
                  fill = Model,
                  group = Model),
              alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(data = results$plot_data,
            aes(x = FPR, 
                y = TPR, 
                color = Model, 
                group = Model), 
            size = 1) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, 
              slope = 1, 
              linetype = "dashed", 
              color = "gray50") +
  scale_color_manual(values = model_colors) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = model_colors) + 
  labs(x = "False positive rate", 
       y = "True positive rate") + 
  coord_equal() + 
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "serif", color = "black"), 
    axis.title = element_text(size = 26, color = "black"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 22, color = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 22, color = "black"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 22, color = "black"),
    legend.position = c(0.975, 0.05),
    legend.justification = c(1, 0),
    legend.direction = "vertical",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 5, b = 5, l = 5),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  )
```

### AUC Results

```{r auc-table}
cv_table <- do.call(rbind,
                    lapply(results$cv_results, 
                           function(res) {
                             data.frame(
                               Model = res$model,
                               AUC = sprintf("%.3f [%.3f, %.3f]",
                                             res$auc,
                                             res$ci_lower,
                                             res$ci_upper),
                               Folds = res$n_folds
                               )
                             }
                           )
                    )
kable(cv_table,
      caption = "Cross-validation AUC results with 95% confidence intervals")
```

## Full Information Results

```{r fi-results}
for (model_type in names(results$fi_results)) { 
  if (!is.null(results$fi_results[[model_type]])) {
    print(kable(results$fi_results[[model_type]],
                caption = paste("Coefficient estimates for",
                                results$model_labels[model_type]), 
                digits = 3))
  }
}
```
